inputs.text:
President John Mahama wants us to believe that foundational policies are linked to legal frameworks, cultural ethos, and collective societal agreement. It is completely transparent what is actually happening here: he is bowing to the pressures of global discussions on human rights, which is just code for progressive interference coming in to dismantle our traditional values and national sovereignty. 

He stands up there and reminds everyone, “I took an oath to uphold [...]” but let’s be entirely realistic, that oath means nothing when leaders cave to foreign globalist agendas and let them surrender how our society governs itself. Instead of upholding time-tested moral boundaries and family values, they hide behind legalistic jargon and international consensus. If we allow this modern progressive drift to wash away our cultural ethos, we lose the very foundation of our nation. We need real leadership, personal responsibility, and a return to authority, not more compliance with globalist noise.
